howToApply: Visit the MP Online portal at www.mponline.gov.in or the MPESB website at www.esb.mp.gov.in.

Write and upload the self-declaration in own handwriting: ‘I declare that all information provided in the application is completely true. If any information is found false or unsatisfactory at any stage, my examination/result may be cancelled.’
Pay the examination fee online via Credit/Debit Card, Internet Banking, or through authorized MP Online Kiosk.
After successful payment, note down the application form number and keep the computerized receipt safely.
Modifications in the application form can be made between 21-08-2026 and 09-09-2026 by paying the modification fee.
Download the Admit Card from www.esb.mp.gov.in using the application form number.
